text:
Priya N.: Quick heads-up: I'm reorganizing the Dedicated Capacity doc into a terse Quickstart + a Deep Dive section. Plan is to move operational detail (isolation, eviction, SLA nuance) into Deep Dive and keep Quickstart copy-pasteable. Thoughts?
Owen T.: Love the split. Can we make Quickstart a single page with 3 runnable examples (terraform, python, go)? Most users copy the first thing they see.
Priya N.: Yes. I'll add 3 examples. Also creating a tiny Known Issues subsection in Deep Dive for autoscale+preemption edge cases and a pointer to the rollout playbook.
Claire S.: Ping me when you have the Known Issues text. I want to ensure we don't leak implementation assumptions.
docs-bot: link-check: broken link found: /handbook/dedicated/preemption -> 404 referenced by handbook/dedicated/operational.md.
Priya N.: Thanks. I'll replace with /handbook/dedicated/behavior/preemption and add a redirect note.
Owen T.: For terraform snippet, please use variable name `reserved_pool_replicas` and include a pre-provision quota check step: `data "redwood_quota" "q" {}` so folks don't hit a surprise error.
Priya N.: Adding that. Draft Terraform snippet:
```terraform
data "redwood_quota" "q" {}
resource "redwood_dedicated_capacity" "prod" {
  name                     = "prod-cap"
  gpu_type                 = "a10g"
  reserved_pool_replicas   = 4
  scale_policy             = "autoscale"
  isolation                = "reserved-pool"
}
```
Owen T.: Nice. For the Python snippet, show how to attach a scale policy object and a cooldown window.
Priya N.: Python draft:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, ScalePolicy
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
policy = ScalePolicy(type="autoscale", cooldown_seconds=300)
client.create_dedicated_capacity(
  name="prod-cap",
  gpu_type="a10g",
  replicas=4,
  scale_policy=policy,
  isolation="reserved-pool"
)
```
Sam L.: Add a short note in Deep Dive about what "isolation=tenant" does vs "reserved-pool" (resource sharing, eviction semantics). Keep it factual.
Priya N.: Will do. Also adding a Migration checklist different from the other doc: steps: 1) Export current routing configs, 2) Run smoke tests against a staging shard, 3) Rotate keys used by automation, 4) Gradual traffic lift with 5% increments, 5) Post-migration sanity alert for 24h.
Claire S.: I'll open a link-fix PR for the preemption path and the SLA anchor.
docs-bot: PR created (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9901 (Priya N.)
eng-runtime: @Priya N. please cc runtime on the Known Issues section regarding preemption interactions so we don't publish assumptions that conflict with runtime behaviour.
Priya N.: Will tag @eng-runtime and also add TODO to follow up after runtime confirms behaviour.
Owen T.: One nit for the Quickstart: include example values for the GPU type and replica count so users can test locally.
Priya N.: Good call. I'll include a small runnable checklist at top of Quickstart and then merge Deep Dive content behind a collapsible section. Will request reviews from @Claire S., @Sam L., and @eng-runtime.
Claire S.: I'll review once draft is out.
Priya N.: Thanks all, posting draft now and will ping reviewers in #docs-review.
